Subject: Renewal: VPC topology augmentation & conversion plan

Hi Irene —

As we look toward the March renewal, we'd like to convert our single VPC footprint into a split topology to isolate analytics traffic from PHI-processing workloads. Current asks from our infra team: add two dedicated clusters for analytics (EU region), a strict network carve-out for PHI with separate VPN termination, and a 13-month term instead of 12 to align with our fiscal calendar.

Can Redwood provide an updated topology recommendation, estimated lead times for stand-up, and a rough TTL on costs so we can queue procurement? I've attached our usage summary (MAAP v2) and a sketched topology from our side.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Best,
Elena Rossi
VP of Engineering, MedNexa
Elena.Rossi@mednexa.com

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear brief and the attachments. High level: we can provision two additional dedicated clusters in eu-west-1, enable a strict VPC carve-out with customer-managed VPN termination, and switch the renewal to a 13-month cadence. We should validate peak-token concurrency (your MAAP sheet helps) to size cluster types (reserved T4 vs. P4 equivalents).

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal: VPC topology augmentation & conversion plan — technical sketch

Elena / team —

Thanks for the MAAP and sketch. A few technical clarifications to lock the design:
1) Do the analytics clusters need read-only access to PHI token caches, or should they be fully isolated with ETL exports? Isolation is preferred for compliance.
2) Expected peak concurrent requests for analytics (p50/p95) — MAAP shows monthly tokens but not concurrency; can you provide a 24-hr spike sample?
3) Who will own VPN termination — MedNexa side or us? Customer-managed VPN termination is supported; if MedNexa manages, we just validate tunnels and routing.

Assuming strict isolation (no direct PHI access):
- Proposed: two dedicated cluster pools, one sized for short, high-concurrency analytics (8 x high-memory GPUs), one for PHI (4 x secure GPU nodes with KMS/HSM integration).
- Network: hub-and-spoke within your VPC, separate route tables + security groups, explicit CIDR allocations.
- Cutover plan: staggered — stand up analytics cluster and run synthetic load tests, then parallel-validation with PHI cluster behind a QA gate.

I've attached a quick topology diagram and a rough capacity sizing table (see network-topology-sketch.png). If you confirm isolation + provide concurrency numbers, I can finalize a firm SLA and runbook.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: network-topology-sketch.png
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 16:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal: VPC topology augmentation & conversion plan — commercial options

Elena —

Great to be working on this. Commercial notes:
- Option A (Standard conversion): 13-month term, two additional dedicated cluster pools. Pricing in attached PDF (redwood-quote-DEC2026.pdf). No expedite.
- Option B (Accelerated): same capacity, 3–4 week lead with expedite fee (one-time) and priority order.
- Option C (Phased uplift): bring analytics cluster first (lower immediate cost), PHI cluster at +3 months — helpful if you want to spread spend.

Key callouts: 1) The 13-month term moves invoice cadence; procurement typically signs an addendum to the master services agreement. 2) We can include a one-time migration/validation credit if you commit to 24 months total across both clusters.

I've cc'd Ben from account operations to start preparing an AMS addendum and a DocuSign payload once you pick a path.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks all — we had a procurement sync this morning. Quick answers:
- Isolation: required. Analytics must not have live PHI access; ETL exports to a sanitized view will be used.
- Concurrency: preliminary spike sample attached (MAAP supplemental) — p95 concurrency ~420 requests.
- VPN termination: MedNexa will manage VPN termination (we have a dedicated firewall team).

We're inclined to Option C (Phased uplift). Start with analytics cluster in Q1, then PHI cluster on +3 months. Procurement asked for the AMS addendum + 13-month invoice term and a DocuSign link for signatures. Also asked for clear lead times per option to finalize internal approvals.

Can you send the addendum + DocuSign by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Elena
